evidence: Swap (fail): the frame (white masthead with small icon + bold wordmark, pale green-grey ground, white 4px bordered cards with a square thumbnail tile, one dark-green filled button, a single sans) survives unchanged if the content is replaced by a vet booking or a council allotment waitlist; only the copy is bound to the library.

Category-guess (fail): the predicted default for a community/charity booking flow is a pale ground, one green 'community' accent, bordered cards, a system-like humanist sans and outline icons; every identity-carrying element matches that default. No element matches an opposite, but none departs from the default either.
Similar-prompt (fail): 'online booking for a neighbourhood repair cafe' would land on the same masthead, card grid, green CTA and month calendar; the overlap covers the first viewport entirely.
Thumbnail tiles on the find page show the same wrench glyph on all 10 tools (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png), so the only imagery slot carries no product information.

What is bound to the product is copy and content: tool names a volunteer would use ('Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries'), deposits on every card, 'Available from Sat 10 Oct', the calendar's 'Open' session markers (tool/day-chosen/1280-light.png) and 'Bring your membership card and the deposit'. These are good but sit on a frame that fails all three tests (rubric anchor 1).
